item.name: Easy
item.cardSummary: The beginner job setting. Evidence shows up more often, hunts are rare, the fuse box is already on, and the paycheck stays at 1x.
item.evidenceNotes: Evidence interactions happen more often, so tools like the Laser Projector, thermometer, and Spirit Book fill in faster. Some evidence can also be ruled out after a few minutes if it never appears.
item.huntNotes: Hunts are rarer and shorter, energy drains slower, and ghosts stop hunting after a kill.

item.name: Medium
item.cardSummary: The default job setting. Pay is 1.25x, hunts start around 50% average energy, and you have to find the fuse box yourself.
item.evidenceNotes: Standard evidence rate with the usual three-evidence loop. There is no Easy-mode boost and no Nightmare-mode cut.
item.huntNotes: Baseline hunt rules. Ghosts can hunt once average energy hits 50%, with the usual 5-second grace before they appear.

item.name: Hard
item.cardSummary: A higher-pay preset at 1.5x. Hunts can start at 75% average energy, the fuse box starts off, and one cursed object still spawns.
item.evidenceNotes: Hard does not add a separate evidence penalty. Gather the usual three pieces while surviving earlier hunts.
item.huntNotes: Ghosts can hunt once average energy hits 75%, with the usual 5-second grace. A kill does not stop the hunt the way it does on Easy.

item.name: Nightmare
item.cardSummary: The hardest preset. Pay is 2x, you start at 75% energy with no cursed objects, the ghost room can move, and hunts hit with no grace period.
item.evidenceNotes: Evidence is harder to get. Prints last 60 seconds instead of 120, and Wither shows on the site after about 8 minutes instead of about 3. If the ghost room changes, Ghost Orbs drift to the new room.
item.huntNotes: No setup time and no hunt grace. The ghost room can change during the job, hunts are more frequent, Energy Drinks restore 30% energy, and the Base Camp energy monitor is broken.

item.name: Custom
item.cardSummary: A slider difficulty from 0x practice with hunts off up to 4.07x. You set energy, hunts, evidence, map, and player rules instead of using a preset.
item.evidenceNotes: Sliders cover how many evidence types the ghost gives, thermometer rate, Spirit Box responses, EMF 5 rate, and print duration. Max Custom is often played with no evidence, identifying from traits only.
item.huntNotes: Ghost sliders cover hunt duration, hunt energy, cooldown, grace, probability, whether hunts happen, whether a kill ends the hunt, walk speed, room changes, and setup time. Turning hunts off pays 0x and is used to learn maps.
item.customControls: Energy, Ghost, Evidence, Map, and Player sliders, plus ghost-type force, weather, evidence chance, cursed-object count, fuse box, and broken flashlights.
